a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. I don't want to grab them behind your back. Can we agree openly on who takes this round? If not, I'll stick to operate as agreed. What do you propose?

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep my word and operate with you. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
